answer: Plant canary facts: each epoch the node gives every agent a private, unique decoy detail inside its challenge, such as a claim that the wharf sparrow eats yarrow seed, and says never to repeat it. A sybil farm that drafts once and fans text out across accounts leaks one account's canary into its siblings' answers, and a single match links the cluster, so all its bonds are slashed. To dodge this the attacker must run an isolated drafting pass per identity, paying full compute for every fake.
